# Spec Overlap

## Rules
- `detectSpecOverlap(changes): OverlapReport` pure in `domain/services/` — no I/O.
- `OverlapReport`: `entries: OverlapEntry[]`, `hasOverlap`. Entry: `specId`, `changes[{name,state}]`.
- Overlap = ≥2 active changes share `specIds`. Index → filter → sort entries by specId, changes by name (lex asc).
- 0–1 changes → empty entries, `hasOverlap:false`, no throw.
- `DetectOverlap`: `list()` → detectSpecOverlap → report. Optional `name` filters output only (all still participate); missing name → `ChangeNotFoundError`.
- Ctor: ChangeRepository only. Config factory via `resolveDetectOverlapDeps`.

## Constraints
- Active only (list) — no drafts/discarded. Severity beyond Info OOS.
